qualificationBasis: Signals are grouped by exact Polymarket condition and outcome, including individual player props. Strong Signals require each holder to have a complete rolling 30-day closed-position record, with one net realized-P&L result per market and early closes included; 20+ resolved markets; 90%+ profitable-close rate; positive 30-day realized P&L; and verified $10+ entry/current value. Seven-day leaderboard P&L is displayed separately as recent performance.

scanDiagnostics.note: Consensus discovery scans up to 100 positions for each general wallet and up to 200 for sports-category wallets, across up to 20,000 selected wallets. Active holdings worth $3+ are discovered; Strong Signals retain the $10 verified entry/current-value gate. Exact market condition and outcome are grouped separately. Sports may remain eligible for 48 hours; other categories use 24 hours.

candidatePoolBasis: Up to 20,000 unique wallets selected from public Data API v2 leaderboard discovery across sports, crypto, esports, politics, culture, mentions, weather, economics, tech, finance, and overall categories. The public API does not expose a literal all-wallet directory. The scan checks up to 200 open positions for sports-category wallets and 100 for other wallets. Discovery includes active positions worth $3+; the Strong Signals tier keeps its separate $10+ entry/current-value requirement.
recordBasis: Strong Signals: every listed trader independently passes a complete rolling 30-day closed-position record, counted once per market by net realized P&L, including early closes; at least 20 resolved markets; 90%+ profitable-close rate; positive 30-day realized P&L; and verified $10+ entry/current value. Seven-day leaderboard P&L is shown separately. Player props are grouped by exact market and outcome. This is a research signal, not a proven profitable strategy.

qualificationCount.basis: Unique wallets from the discovered public leaderboard candidate pool; complete closed-position records within the last 7 days; one net profitable/unprofitable result per market. Early exits count as closes. This is a sampled candidate-pool count, not a census of every Polymarket wallet.
